status: pre-registered before any exp10 model was trained

base.cache: Kaggle kernel output akshayalgox/amlc26-exp7-h1-dump (version 2): h1_matcher_oof.parquet, h1_queries.parquet, h1_truth.parquet
base.rebuilt: nothing upstream of the matcher: retrieval, TF-IDF, candidate pool, parsing, pruner and exp7 pair features all come from the cache

folds: exp7 folds (salt amlc26-exp7-fold-v1, 5 folds) and exp7 early-stopping subset, recomputed from s1_id and asserted equal to the cached fold column
row_order: exp7 matcher row order = sort by (q, prune_rank); B0 must reproduce the cached OOF p (max abs diff reported)

lightgbm.num_threads: os.cpu_count() (4 on Kaggle CPU, as in exp7)

arms.B2: anchor: exp9 B2 recipe, must reproduce 0.9394136402248061 exactly
arms.B2nc: B2 minus the `country` feature (country-agnostic model for unseen France)
arms.B2t40: B2 on rows with prune_rank <= 40 (Top-40 budget)
arms.B2lc50: B2 trained on a fixed 50% of training S1 per fold (sha256('amlc26-exp10-lc|'+s1_id) % 100 < 50)

decision_rule: exp7 family and grids, selected per arm on DEV cross-fitted OOF only (as exp9)

decisions.country_agnostic_for_h4: adopt B2nc for H4 iff delta >= -0.0005 and no category drops > 0.002
decisions.top40_budget_for_h4: adopt Top-40 iff delta >= -0.0005 and no category drops > 0.002
decisions.more_training_s1: plan a larger-training run iff the 20k->40k gain >= 0.003 (a doubling)

holdouts: H2, H3 and H4 are not read; H3 + H4 sealed in the store
